descricao: As mentioned prior, this level is a planetoid object. Said object orbits a star referred to as Calor, which is identical to that of The Frontrooms Sun. On top of this, Level 70 has a moon referred to as Frigus which acts almost the same as the one in the Frontrooms, with the only difference being its ability to change colour anomalously. These are believed to be the only celestial bodies on this level. Because of Frigus, Level 70 has a normal day-night cycle. Though the addition of night doesn't change much, some parts of the level have a slight increase of entities during this time.
entidades: Facelings, Drowners, Skin-Stealers, Smilers, Hounds, Deathmoths, Faceling, Skin Stealers, Death Rats, Dunks
